title: No CLI platform file is selected
description: TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md lists only Go, common shell, and JSON Lines. No cli.md is selected, so the CLI shape comes from go.md's native CLI layout.
system_choice: Use go.md's native CLI layout: cmd/ddkstat main calls internal/cli Run(args, stdout, stderr) int. Select no cli.md.

title: No DATABASE.md is authored
description: The analysis and sources describe a read-only JSON Lines file with no persistent store, and the stack is standard library only.
system_choice: Author no DATABASE.md and no persistence.md stack entry. The log is file input, not persistent state.

title: bin/test.sh is created by the foundation, not by BLD-002
description: COMPASS.md requires every behavioral story to run sh bin/test.sh, but ANALYSIS.md sequences BLD-002 after all report stories. Both cannot hold unless the launcher exists before the first behavioral story.
system_choice: go-foundation creates bin/test.sh as a launcher so every behavioral story can run the Verification Protocol. The test-suite story (BLD-002) finalizes it and carries st-002, after all implementation stories.

title: Terminal gate asserts exit status only
description: sources/run.sh is the authoritative conformance suite. It exits zero only when the build succeeds and every one of its 20 checks passes.
system_choice: The terminal story declares Suite: full and asserts returncode == 0 with no re-typed count or known answer. Run.sh output is printed for diagnosis only.

title: Report dispatch table is shared
description: Six report stories each register a name in the same dispatch table in internal/cli, which creates edit contention if they run in parallel.
system_choice: cli-parse owns the table. report-summary runs first, and the other report stories depend on it so they edit the table one at a time.
